claim_boundary: Retrospective diagnostic only. Target deltas define the already sealed unsafe/safe outcome groups, but no raw target mask, score, or new target run is opened. No threshold or deployment branch may be selected from these outcomes.

fixed_reliability_test.strict_rank_separation: For a lower-is-unsafe statistic require max(unsafe)<min(safe); for a higher-is-unsafe statistic require min(unsafe)>max(safe).
fixed_reliability_test.pairwise_concordance: Report the fraction of unsafe-safe pairs ordered in the preregistered unsafe direction, with ties worth 0.5.
fixed_reliability_test.reliable_identification: At least one individual existing statistic must achieve strict rank separation. No statistic combination, fitted weight, threshold sweep, scene-specific exception, or sign flip is allowed.
fixed_reliability_test.pass_action: A later source-only cross-scene calibration may be separately preregistered; do not run target.
fixed_reliability_test.fail_action: Conclude existing source statistics cannot identify all three regressions reliably and stop this routing direction without a second target run.

forbidden: open raw target masks or target scores
select a numeric threshold from target outcomes
fit a multivariate classifier or statistic weights
